description: This file defines the AccountDao interface for database operations related to Account entities in an Android application using Room persistence library. It includes methods for inserting, deleting, querying, and updating account data, with specific focus on account properties such as id, url, username, account name, eTag, modified timestamp, api version, color, text color, capabilities, display name, and editing capabilities.

classes.name: AccountDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations on Account entities.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Account into the database and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the specified Account from the database.

methods.name: getAccounts$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all accounts with detailed fields.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all accounts with detailed fields.

methods.name: getAccountById$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object for the account with the specified ID.

methods.name: getAccountById
methods.description: Returns the account with the specified ID.

methods.name: getAccountByName
methods.description: Retrieves an account by its account name.

methods.name: countAccounts$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object with the count of all accounts.

methods.name: updateBrand
methods.description: Updates the color (brand) of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateETag
methods.description: Updates the eTag of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateCapabilitiesETag
methods.description: Updates the capabilities eTag of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateModified
methods.description: Updates the modified timestamp of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateApiVersion
methods.description: Updates the API version of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name of the account identified by ID.

methods.name: updateDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Sets whether direct editing is available for the account identified by ID.
